vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: email-finder
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle is classified as suspicious primarily due to a significant security vulnerability in `scripts/find_emails.py`: it disables SSL certificate verification (`ssl.CERT_NONE`) when fetching web pages, exposing the agent to potential Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attacks. Additionally, the script performs extensive network requests (HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, SMTP) which, while aligned with its stated purpose of email finding, represent high-risk capabilities. There is no evidence of intentional malicious behavior like data exfiltration, persistence, or prompt injection against the agent in `SKILL.md`.
